contentHtml:
Neuro Synergy 2026 brought together experts from neurosurgery and spine surgery, neurology, neurocritical care, neurotrauma, neuro-oncology, neuro modulation and neuroradiology, highlighting the importance of a multidisciplinary approach in managing complex brain and spine conditions

Max Super Speciality Hospital, Vaishali, organised Neuro Synergy 2026 bringing together around 200 clinicians and medical experts from Delhi-NCR and upcountry regions to discuss advancements in neurosurgery, neurology and specialised neurological care. The conference served as a collaborative platform for specialists across multiple disciplines to exchange knowledge, discuss complex clinical challenges and explore newer approaches to the diagnosis and treatment of neurological disorders.

Neuro Synergy 2026 brought together experts from neurosurgery and spine surgery, neurology, neurocritical care, neurotrauma, neuro-oncology, neuro modulation and neuroradiology, highlighting the importance of a multidisciplinary approach in managing complex brain and spine conditions. The programme was led by Dr Hrishikesh Chakrabartty, Director- Neuro & Spine Surgery, Max Super Speciality Hospital, Vaishali.

Emphasising the need for coordinated and patient-centric care, Dr Chakrabartty said, “Neurological disorders often require the expertise of multiple specialties, as timely diagnosis, appropriate clinical decisions and coordinated interventions can significantly influence patient outcomes. Neuro Synergy 2026 has provided an important platform for specialists to share their experiences, discuss challenging cases and understand the latest advancements in medical and surgical neurosciences. Our endeavour is to strengthen collaboration and ensure that patients have access to comprehensive, evidence-based and advanced neurological care under one roof.”

One of the major highlights of the conference was the simulation-based neurosurgical skills workshop titled ‘Practice Before Precision’, designed to provide hands-on learning and exposure to advanced surgical techniques. The workshop covered three key areas: neuroendovascular interventions under the theme ‘Inside the Vessel’, monoportal spine endoscopy through ‘Scope, Dock & Decompress’, and 3D spinal deformity correction focusing on screw, rod and realignment techniques. The conference also featured expert-led panel discussions, symposiums, video presentations of complex surgical cases and an e-poster competition.

Speaking on the conference, Dr Gaurav Aggarwal, Director-Hospital Operations & Chief Operating Officer, (NCR Region 3), Max Healthcare, said, “The Institute of Neurosciences at Max Super Speciality Hospital, Vaishali, is firmly established as one of the finest and most comprehensive centres for brain and spine care in the entire region. We are continuously advancing our capabilities across the entire spectrum of neurosciences. Platforms like Neuro Synergy foster innovation and academic exchange, reinforcing our commitment to delivering cutting-edge, accessible, and world-class neurological care to our patients.”
